description: M10 coarse (P 1.5) external thread over the whole length of a r=5 h=18 cylinder (12 pitches)
formula: V = pi r^2 h - (h/p) int w(r) 2 pi r dr, w = p/4 + 2 (r - r1) tan 30, r1 = d/2 - 5H/8, H = sqrt3/2 p (ISO 68-1)

meshTolerance.reason: mesh kernel: the cylinder is an inscribed n-gon (volume loss k (1 - cos(pi/n)) / the clipped groove outer edge) and the groove tool is faceted (32 rings per turn)

knownFailure.measured: volume 1181.47 (rel +7.6e-3), centroid (0, -0.018, -0.068); export_step_ap242 writes the faceted body and the STEP round trip keeps that volume
knownFailure.diagnosis: add_external_thread cuts a faceted groove tool (32 rings per turn) on every kernel, so on OCCT the result is a mesh body with no B-rep recipe: mesh-tolerance volume (export_step_ap242 now writes it as a faceted solid). An exact helical sweep groove in the native kernel would close this.
